meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂工作分解为循证步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把模糊目标拆解成可执行、有依据的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex work into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decompose vague goals into actionable, evidence-backed steps

howto.what: 装上后,它会把你给的目标拆成很多小步骤,一次只做一步,逐条记进度;每步都在真实环境(终端、网页、浏览器等)里验证并留证据;改代码、测试或审查时,派给专门子代理,自己负责指挥。
howto.when: 当你说出「ulw-loop」「ulw」等关键词,或要求做长期目标执行、证据驱动工作、手动 QA 等时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 分解并执行这个长期项目,逐步验证。
say.note: Claude 会按流程拆解、记录并验证每一步。

say.text: 开启证据驱动模式,把每步结果对应到真实环境。
say.note: 每步都会在终端或浏览器等环境留下证据。

say.text: ulw 模式跑这个任务,并做手动 QA。
say.note: Claude 会安排手动质量检查点。

howto.what_en: Claude decomposes your goal into tiny steps, does one at a time, and logs each. It verifies every step on a real surface (terminal, web, browser) and keeps evidence. For code, tests, or QA, it delegates to subagents and directs them.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "ulw-loop" or "ulw", or asks for long-running goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, etc.

say_en.text: Run ulw-loop on this long-term project, verifying each step.
say_en.note: Claude breaks down, logs, and verifies each step.

say_en.text: Turn on evidence-led mode and map each result to a real surface.
say_en.note: Each step leaves evidence in terminal or browser.

say_en.text: Run this task in ulw mode with manual QA.
say_en.note: Manual QA checkpoints are set for each deliverable.
